name: Amon
charge: Serving his father's idols and refusing his father's repentance
summary: Manasseh's son reigned two years, sacrificed to all the carved images his father had made, and humbled not himself before the Lord as Manasseh had humbled himself, but trespassed more and more.
offense: He had both examples in one man, the apostasy and the repentance, and chose the first. He forsook the Lord God of his fathers and walked not in the way of the Lord.
judgment: His own servants conspired against him and slew him in his house. The people of the land killed the conspirators and made Josiah, eight years old, king in his stead.

2 Chronicles 33: Manasseh's Wickedness and His Humbling

lawsResolved.text: You shall not engage in idolatry and worship or serve the gods, idols or graven images of other nations.
Warnings of the iniquity of turning from God.
Unless you repent you will perish.

text.text: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh did.
And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.
And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
But he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
And humbled not himself before the Lord, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
